notes.title: The Cruel Dreamer Marchosias Update Stream
notes.content:
Celebrating the 3rd month of release for "The Cruel Dreamer Marchosias" and the updates with a live stream. If you have any questions about the game, feel free to drop by during the stream, make some nachos and chill out for the event.

Update:

The live stream will be streamed over on Twitch under "The Cruel Dreamer Marchosias" Dakoda_Vs_The_Backlog

Sorry about the switch!

notes.title: Game Update and Halloween discount
notes.content:
Thank you everyone for playing "The Cruel Dreamer Marchosias". I really appreciate everyone for playing the game and I hope you enjoy the updates! A few updates to the game include:

- Terrain
- Level updates and fixes
- Player movement
- Phantasm movement 
- Clipping in certain levels

notes.title: Update on game release!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41336997/2f65bbf7360f6fd4172f2db8747453e897bd948a.png

Hi everyone!

Just wanted to take the time to let everyone know about an update to the game demo and some information regarding the release of this game. First off, thank you everyone who played the beta and the demo. Really appreciate the time you all took to try out the game in its current state, as for the release date looking to become available in Q2 of 2022. I'm still in the process of adding more content to the game, polishing up the levels more , as well as adding in some much needed features to improve the game and player experience. 

Once again, thank you everyone for your patience with this game. I can't wait for you all to play the full release version, and will be working hard over these next few months to make this game worth your time.

Will also be doing a lot more updates/posts in the future, I wish I could say I just realized how to make posts but that sounds like a bad excuse so be on the lookout for more info!

regards,

Dakoda
